description: Offline Hold the Briefcase on Complex: one human plus three simulants, started through the direct debug match path and ended by a 150 second time limit. Proves the match-start contract for an objective scenario: the launch seed derives the runtime mode from the scenario catalog id, mpStartMatch initializes the scenario, the stage loads, the player spawns, the time limit ends the match, and the result witness lists every participant. It does not yet assert an objective scoring event; that needs the per-scenario objective witness. B-1126: on an arena with no multiplayer ammo crate and no usable case pad (every extracted arena today), the briefcase bank gets eight spaced walkable pads, so the briefcase no longer always starts on pad 0; the smoke asserts that it starts on a real pad from a crate or the bank, which also holds once the arenas carry their own pads. Local scoring (T-NETWORKING-011): a 150 second match lets the simulants score, as the networked runs did, and the result must show at least one nonzero score.

input_sequence.comment: Boot, seed the Combat Simulator config for this scenario, and fire the direct debug match start.
Bounded exit after stage load, a 150 second match and the end screen.

required_lines: MATCH\.SCENARIO\.RULES: reason=launch-mp-room id='base:hold_the_briefcase' mode=1 team_based=0 teams_enabled_here=0
PLAYER\.INIT\.PREFLIGHT match=ok players=1 bots=3 stage='base:arena_mp_complex' scenario='base:hold_the_briefcase'
HTB: briefcase placed pad=[1-9][0-9]* source=(crate|bank) prop=ok
forbidden_patterns: HTB: briefcase placed pad=-?[0-9]+ source=[a-z0-9]+ prop=none
